feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 10 October 2026 5:34am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later.


##Wind)##

NW or W-NW 6 or 7 at first, decreasing 5 or 6, then 4 or 5 later this evening, easing W or W-NW 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, occasionally rough in places at first, becoming slight or moderate later today & tonight.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers, fair later.


##Visibility)##

Good, possibly falling moderate in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

W or W-NW 3 or less, soon backing SW or Southerly 2 to 4, then SE 5 or 6 during the evening. Veering Southerly 4 at the end of the night.


##State of sea)##

Slight, falling smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Fair, then rain arriving later in the evening & overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in the rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 14°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
